WITH circuit_stats AS (
  SELECT
    circuitId,
    COUNT(*) as race_count,
    AVG(round) as avg_round
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
),
total_races AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM races
)
SELECT
  cs.circuitId,
  cs.avg_round,
  cs.race_count,
  CAST(cs.race_count AS FLOAT) / tr.total as share
FROM circuit_stats cs
CROSS JOIN total_races tr
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10
